thread_title: Sarracenia flava var. ornata Horry Co, SC
breadcrumb: Sarracenia flava var. ornata Horry Co, SC

posts.body_html:
ornatas from Horry Co, SC are pretty rare in cultivation, and here's a nice one with some decent veining! pictured are small divisions from the mother plant...the main clone with bigger traps got shaded by surrounding flavas, so it's not as photogenic right now. Hopefully I'll get more impressive photos next spring! Nevertheless, when you see very small traps producing very heavy veining, you know it's a good one!
